name: Millet muesli
ingredients: Rolled Oats (33.6%), Millets(20.2%) [Jowar(10.2%), Ragi(10%)], Brown Rice Fakes (15%), Seeds(12%) [Flax(8%), Chia(2%), Pumpkin(2%)], Corn Flakes (5%), Black Raisins (4%), Almonds (3%), Rice Flour(4.2%), Rice Bran Oil, Chia Seeds, Anticaking Agent [INS 170(i)] , Natural Flavour, Antioxidant [INS(307(b), INS 320], Acidity Regulator[INS 330].
